fusions.name: Ink Jet
fusions.desc: Squirts a jet of ink that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and has a 60% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Eightfold Kicks
fusions.desc: Lashes out with 8 kicks at once, spread wide, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Cloud of Ink
fusions.desc: Veils you in ink for 4 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and you move 30% faster while veiled. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Shaken Loose
fusions.desc: When a condition on you expires, your critical hit chance rises 12% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
